scope: Four-task Code80 subset; two fixed repeats per arm; not a full leaderboard score.

definitions.reward: mean of verifier-reported per-trial score; build_error -> 0
definitions.pass_rate: fraction of trials with verifier score >= 1.0
definitions.score_source: score.json reward > overall > test_pass_rate > tests_passed/tests_total fallback
definitions.aggregation: mean over attempts within each task, then mean over tasks
definitions.denominator_rebasing: pure test-count attempts are re-scored as tests_passed/max(tests_total) across a task's attempts so a shrunken suite cannot inflate the ratio; composite LLM+rule scores are exempt
